Package org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp

Class InMemoryMcpResponseCache

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.InMemoryMcpResponseCache
All Implemented Interfaces:
McpResponseCache
public class InMemoryMcpResponseCache extends Object implements McpResponseCache
Built-in, process-local, in-memory default implementation of McpResponseCache.

Entries are partitioned by scope, so the same key in two different scopes never collides. A non-positive ttlMs passed to put(String, String, Object, long) means the entry never expires.

Size bound / eviction policy:

The cache is bounded at DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES total entries (across all scopes combined) by default, overridable via InMemoryMcpResponseCache(int). Once the cap is reached, inserting one more entry evicts the single least-recently-used entry (an access via get(String, String), whether a hit or a still-live entry, counts as a use; an expired-and-evicted-on-read entry does not) — a bounded default that never grows unboundedly under sustained cache traffic, without needing every caller to reason about a capacity setting themselves.

This class is thread-safe (a synchronized LinkedHashMap in access-order/LRU mode).

Since:
10.0.0
